description: This file defines the TasksAdapter class for displaying a list of tasks in a RecyclerView within an Android application. It includes UI binding, item handling, and diffing logic for task items.

classes.name: TasksAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying a list of TaskEntity items in a RecyclerView, using DiffUtil for efficient updates.

classes.name: TasksAdapter.TaskViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for binding individual task items to the RecyclerView.

methods.name: getItemOrNull
methods.description: Returns the task at the given position or null if out of bounds.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view and creates a TaskViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for the given position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a TaskEntity's data to the view components in the ViewHolder.
